title: Amendment of the Regulations relating to the Protection of Personal Information, 2018
parent_act: Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (Act No. 4 of 2013)
enabling_provision: The Information Regulator has, in accordance with section 113(3) of the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), amended Regulations relating to the Protection of Personal Information Act: Regulations as per: GG 42110, RG 10897, GoN 1383, 14 Dec 2018, in the Schedule.
short_title_and_commencement: These Regulations shall be called the amendment to Regulations relating to the Protection of Personal Information, 2018 and shall commence on a date to be determined by the Regulator by proclamation in the Government Gazette.
source_document: Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (Act 4 of 2013): Amendment of the Regulations relating to the Protection of Personal Information, 2018 (tabled 21 January 2025) [KB 2/Africa/Protection of Personal Information Act.pdf]
